title: French Fries
ingredients: Potatoes, oil for frying, salt, and optional spices like paprika or pepper.
recipe: Potatoes are peeled and cut into thin strips, washed to remove excess starch, and dried well. They are deep-fried in hot oil until golden and crispy, then drained and seasoned with salt before serving hot.

title: Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: Boneless chicken pieces, flour, breadcrumbs, eggs, salt, pepper, and oil.
recipe: Chicken is cut into bite-sized pieces, seasoned, dipped in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs, then deep-fried until crispy and cooked through. Serve hot with dipping sauce.

title: Onion Rings
ingredients: Onions, flour, cornflour, baking powder, salt, water, and oil.
recipe: Onions are sliced into rings and dipped in a smooth batter made with flour and spices. The rings are deep-fried until golden and crunchy and served hot.

title: Mozzarella Sticks
ingredients: Mozzarella cheese sticks, flour, eggs, breadcrumbs, seasoning, and oil.
recipe: Cheese sticks are coated in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs, then frozen briefly. They are deep-fried until crisp on the outside and melted inside.

title: Garlic Bread
ingredients: Bread loaf, butter, garlic, herbs, and salt.
recipe: Butter is mixed with garlic and herbs and spread over sliced bread. The bread is baked until crispy and aromatic and served warm.

title: Nachos
ingredients: Tortilla chips, cheese, jalapeños, salsa, and optional toppings.
recipe: Tortilla chips are layered on a tray, topped with cheese and vegetables, and baked until the cheese melts. Served hot with dips.

title: Pretzels
ingredients: Flour, yeast, sugar, salt, water, baking soda, and butter.
recipe: Dough is prepared, shaped into pretzels, briefly boiled in baking soda water, then baked until golden and finished with butter and salt.

title: Pakora
ingredients: Vegetables, gram flour, spices, water, and oil.
recipe: Vegetables are coated in spiced gram flour batter and deep-fried until crisp and golden. Served hot with chutney.

title: Coleslaw
ingredients: Cabbage, carrots, mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper.
recipe: Shredded cabbage and carrots are mixed with creamy dressing and chilled before serving as a fresh side dish.

title: Tempura
ingredients: Vegetables or seafood, flour, cornflour, ice-cold water, and oil.
recipe: Ingredients are lightly coated in cold batter and deep-fried quickly to create a light, crispy texture.

title: Potato Wedges
ingredients: Potatoes, oil, salt, pepper, and herbs.
recipe: Potatoes are cut into wedges, seasoned, and baked or fried until crispy on the outside and soft inside.

title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: Mixed fresh fruits, honey, lemon juice, and mint.
recipe: Fruits are chopped and gently mixed with honey and lemon juice, then chilled and served fresh.

title: Mac and Cheese Bites
ingredients: Cooked macaroni, cheese sauce, breadcrumbs, eggs, and oil.
recipe: Mac and cheese is shaped into small portions, coated with breadcrumbs, and deep-fried until golden and crispy.

title: Breadsticks
ingredients: Flour, yeast, olive oil, salt, herbs, and water.
recipe: Dough is shaped into sticks, seasoned with herbs, and baked until crisp and lightly golden.

title: Chicken Wings
ingredients: Chicken wings, spices, sauce, oil, and salt.
recipe: Wings are seasoned and baked or fried until crispy, then tossed in sauce and served hot.
